videos.desc: In a cartoon basement experiment a coach with a stopwatch feeds a man a tiny snack that makes a bulb glow faintly, then unveils a whole cake which he devours; he must pedal an exercise bike furiously to burn it all off, but the bulb still blazes bright while he collapses.
videos.said: Small snack, small light. Ooh! Big one, please! Now burn it. All of it. No! It's still bright!

videos.desc: In an animated sunset beach scene, a stern female coach commands a line of trainees with short orders like "Down", "Up", "Run"; they instantly drop into push-ups and sprint along the shore, and she raises her fist.
videos.said: Down. Now. Yes, coach. Up. Run. Hold. Gone.

videos.desc: During a night run on a stadium track, an animated woman suddenly grabs her calf mid-stride and cries "my leg is stuck"; she sits on the track clutching the muscle while her training partner pushes her foot back to stretch it, and after the pain fades she stands up with a thumbs up.
videos.said: Ow! My leg is stuck! Hold on, push against me. It's going. Okay, okay. Better.

videos.desc: At sunrise in a park a mixed group of young and older people stand in rows on the grass and drop together into a deep knee bend with hips down and hands at the chest, coming back up and repeating it in time before moving on to lunges and arm raises.
A tattooed man in a dark 'running club' t-shirt and shorts jogs at a steady pace along an empty wet road at dawn, breathing calmly as street lamps and trees pass behind him.

On a wooden deck surrounded by palm trees, a woman sits cross-legged on a mat with her eyes closed, breathing slowly. A whole group joins her on mats, someone strikes a singing bowl, and they all meditate together in silence as the sun sets behind the jungle.

In a boxing gym a young woman in red gloves throws fast combinations, punching the black focus pads her trainer holds up. She works through jabs and hooks in rhythm and finishes the round laughing with him.
An animated female runner powers down a stadium track at top speed, breaks the red finish tape ahead of the others, then bends over panting and breaks into a happy smile.

In an anime rooftop scene a woman strains at a pull-up bar and cannot lift herself; her friend grips her feet from below and pushes her up until she finishes the pull-up, and they celebrate with a handshake.
videos.said: I can't! I've got you! Push! I did it! Yes!

videos.desc: A sweating cyclist stops on a scorching dirt track and tips his water bottle high over his open mouth, but only a last drop falls out. He grimaces with a dry mouth, stares longingly at sprinklers watering a distant field and keeps shaking the empty bottle.

Two women type at computers in a bright open-plan office. The camera whips round to a long meeting table where a woman in a dark leotard holds a handstand on the tabletop, legs straight up in the air. Colleagues crowd both sides of the table, throwing their arms up, cheering and filming her on their phones.

In a gym lit with purple and green neon, a man and a woman are down on their hands and toes at the start of a marked running track, joined by a long red resistance band. They crawl forwards along the track side by side with their hips low, the band stretching tighter behind them. The band pulls the woman back and she is dragged flat onto her stomach, then ends up sitting on the track laughing while the man stands over her holding the band.

On a wet tree-lined avenue covered with fallen brown leaves, hundreds of runners in numbered bibs race past the camera on both sides. In the middle of the road stands a small old woman in a beige coat and scarf, holding up a large piece of white cardboard with the handwritten words RUN IF YOU THINK I'M SEXY. She stands completely still, smiling, while the runners stream past her towards the start arch in the background.

In a sunny garden dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands barefoot on the mats, other students in white suits watching from the sides. She sets her fists, drops her weight and brings her hand down onto two wooden boards laid across a low wooden stand, splitting them. The stand is reloaded with a block of blue tiles and she raises her fist high above her head and drives it down through them. Finally she squares up to a tall stack of grey concrete slabs, strikes the top of the stack with her hand, and broken pieces fall away onto the mats.

Soldiers in camouflage uniforms train in hand-to-hand combat on a churned muddy field under a grey sky. A woman in uniform drives blow after blow with her gloved fists into a black padded shield held up by a man in front of her. He then grabs her from behind around the chest and they grapple, stumbling in the mud. Around them dozens of other soldiers do the same drill in pairs on grey mats laid over the mud, and at the end she stands close to camera throwing punches into the air, breathing hard.

A woman in teal running kit and a pink cap props one leg on a wooden railing on the Great Wall and stretches at sunrise. She then sets off up the long stone staircase, running at a steady even rhythm, breathing hard, with the watchtower and hills behind her and a few walkers far below.

A phone-held point-of-view shot from inside a road race: the camera runs with the pack along a narrow cobbled street in an old town, passing other runners in numbered vests. Spectators stand behind metal barriers on both sides and clap as the runners go by. The camera drifts sideways past several runners, then holds on one runner in a blue vest striding away up the street between tall pastel buildings.

On a sunny alpine meadow below a wall of snow-covered peaks, two shirtless hikers with big backpacks toil up the grassy slope on trekking poles, skin glistening. One mops his face with his cap and sits down on a boulder, breathing hard; the other drops flat on his back in the grass with his arms out. They drink from water bottles and rest side by side, one sprawled on a wooden bench, the other on the rock.

A very muscular young woman stands at a thatched beach bar in front of a big glass jug on a wooden table. She squeezes an orange in her bare hands until the juice runs into the jug, then picks up a whole watermelon and crushes it between her hands until it bursts and its juice pours into the jug. At the end she turns to the camera and flexes her bicep while the guests behind her laugh and cheer with their drinks.

Early morning in a misty park among tall thin trees, the sun burning through the haze. A woman in a coral top and leggings stands on a low stone platform leading a group of mostly older people through an exercise routine: arms stretched overhead with hands clasped, then a side bend, then bending down to touch her toes, with the whole group copying her behind. A large ginger cat walks along the stone ledge right beside her and stretches its front legs out with its back arched, matching her movement, then sits calmly at her feet while she and the group raise both arms to the sky.

A rooftop terrace at sunset, city blocks and potted plants along the parapet, the sun a bright disc low in a hazy orange sky. A woman in a plum top and leggings works through poses on a mat: she folds forward with straight legs and both palms flat on the mat, looking up at the camera; rises into a high lunge with both arms lifted overhead and her gaze up; leans back over a straight rear leg with one arm reaching behind her; sits into a wide-legged forward fold reaching for one foot; and finally lies chest-down along her front leg with both arms stretched out on the mat in front of her.

A young boxer stands in a dim boxing gym with punchbags and other fighters training behind him. His grey shirt is soaked through with a big dark patch of sweat down the chest, his face and hair are wet, and he talks straight into the camera between hard breaths without softening. At the end he lifts a white towel with hands wrapped in red boxing wraps and rubs it over his head.

An older woman with short white hair, a cap and a bright pink jacket makes her way on foot along a gravel path in a lakeside park, planting a Nordic walking pole with each hand as she goes. She passes another person on foot near a bench, then follows the path beside grey water with ducks on it, stops to look at the smartwatch on her wrist, and carries on past a stone fountain with hills and a town on the far shore.

A bright living room with white curtains and a pale floor. A young woman in a purple sports bra and leggings squats with her arms held straight out in front of her, then drops onto a teal exercise mat and pushes up into a high plank with a phone timer and a water bottle on the floor beside her. She lowers onto her forearms into an elbow plank and holds it, face tight with effort as the timer counts up. At the end she drops flat onto her back on the mat, arms spread, breathing hard.

A bright concrete stairwell during a move. On the top landing a young woman in a blue vest top and black joggers, her hair in a long braid, steps down from a stair and stands holding a whole beige two-seat sofa above her head on her own, smiling easily. Below her a young man in a white T-shirt and maroon shorts slips on the steps hugging one big cushion, and at the bottom a young woman in a mustard jumper carries a floor lamp and looks up. A cardboard box and a potted plant stand by the tall window.
